acceptance_criteria: New fields present on ValidationPolicy. Each field enforced in chain_walk with a distinct Error variant. Unit tests green. No existing tests broken.
close_reason: All child beads completed: Error variants, ValidationPolicy fields, enforcement in chain_walk, DER fixtures, tests, regression verification.
description:
ValidationPolicy in pkix-path/src/lib.rs currently has no way to express:
- Maximum certificate validity period (seconds or days)
- Allowed signature algorithm OIDs (allowlist)
- Minimum RSA key size (bits)
- Required extensions (e.g. SAN must be present on leaf)
- Required EKU OIDs on leaf

These are needed by all three CA/B Forum profile functions in pkix-profiles. Without them the profiles cannot set any constraints that validate_path will actually enforce.

Work:
1. Add fields to ValidationPolicy (all optional / None = unconstrained):
   - max_validity_secs: Option<u64>  — reject any cert whose (notAfter - notBefore) exceeds this
   - allowed_signature_algs: Option<Vec<ObjectIdentifier>>  — if Some, reject any cert whose signature algorithm OID is not in the list
   - min_rsa_key_bits: Option<u32>  — reject RSA public keys smaller than this
   - require_subject_alt_name: bool  — if true, leaf must have a non-empty SAN extension
   - required_leaf_eku: Option<Vec<ObjectIdentifier>>  — if Some, leaf must assert all listed EKU OIDs

2. Enforce each field in chain_walk / check_leaf (pkix-path/src/lib.rs). Add a new Error variant for each new rejection reason (e.g. Error::ValidityPeriodExceedsMax, Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed already exists — reuse if applicable, Error::KeyTooSmall, Error::MissingSan, Error::MissingEku).

3. Update ValidationPolicy::new() and Default to leave all new fields as None / false.

4. Update #[non_exhaustive] note in rustdoc.

5. Unit tests in pkix-path for each new field: one test that passes with the constraint, one that fails.

Note: allowed_signature_algs may overlap with existing algorithm dispatch. Be precise about where in chain_walk the check fires (it should fire before signature verification so the error is diagnostic, not a confusing SignatureInvalid).
title: Extend ValidationPolicy with profile-enforcement fields
